description: This file contains unit tests for directory opening functions in the Starboard platform, including various scenarios such as valid directory opening, null error handling, invalid paths, and platform-specific skips.

methods.name: EXPECT_FILE_EXISTS
methods.description: Macro to check if a file exists, expects true.

methods.name: TEST(SbDirectoryOpenTest, SunnyDay)
methods.description: Test case for opening a temporary directory successfully.

methods.name: TEST(SbDirectoryOpenTest, SunnyDayStaticContent)
methods.description: Test case for opening multiple static directory paths, skips on Android.

methods.name: TEST(SbDirectoryOpenTest, SunnyDayWithNullError)
methods.description: Test opening a directory with a null error pointer.

methods.name: TEST(SbDirectoryOpenTest, ManySunnyDay)
methods.description: Test opening many directories up to maximum open limit.

methods.name: TEST(SbDirectoryOpenTest, FailsInvalidPath)
methods.description: Test opening a directory with a path that appears valid but does not exist.

methods.name: TEST(SbDirectoryOpenTest, FailsNullPath)
methods.description: Test opening a directory with a null path.

methods.name: TEST(SbDirectoryOpenTest, FailsNullPathWithNullError)
methods.description: Test opening a directory with null path and null error pointer.

methods.name: TEST(SbDirectoryOpenTest, FailsEmptyPath)
methods.description: Test opening a directory with an empty string as path.

methods.name: TEST(SbDirectoryOpenTest, FailsRegularFile)
methods.description: Test opening a directory with a path that is a regular file.
